name: v273_mna_sentiment_largecap_fade
hypothesis: M&A sentiment can be over-extrapolated by investors; applying the successful large-cap slow fade template to M&A-specific sentiment tests a corporate-action route distinct from earnings-evaluation sentiment.
field_notes: Template transfer from npg5egk8, replacing earnings_evaluation_sentiment with low-use merger_acquisition_sentiment.

name: v273_mna_sentiment_largecap_follow
hypothesis: If M&A-specific sentiment represents real corporate-action information rather than overreaction, the follow direction should outperform the fade direction.
field_notes: Single sign ablation for the M&A-specific route.

name: v273_technical_impact_largecap_fade
hypothesis: Technical-analysis news impact may be a crowded attention signal; fading it in large caps after smoothing may produce a lower-correlation behavioral alpha.
field_notes: Uses low-use rp_nip_technical with vector-safe transform. If vec_avg is incompatible, close this field form.

name: v273_society_impact_largecap_fade
hypothesis: Society-related projected news impact may be slow-moving and less overlapped with existing accounting/analyst alphas; a fade tests whether public-attention spikes mean-revert.
field_notes: Uses low-use rp_nip_society with the successful cap-gated slow industry template.

name: v273_society_event_sentiment_largecap_fade
hypothesis: Event sentiment for society-related news may differ from projected impact; this tests a second society-specific news surface under the same robust template.
field_notes: Uses rp_ess_society, which is low-use but may be event/vector typed.

name: v273_earnings_release_indicator_largecap_fade
hypothesis: The earnings-release event indicator may capture post-event attention rather than sentiment; a large-cap slow fade tests whether repeated release-event attention mean-reverts without reusing earnings-evaluation sentiment.
field_notes: Uses low-use nws18_ber_fast_d1 indicator, intentionally distinct from earnings_evaluation_sentiment.
